description:
Check out JMP’s workshop here: https://www.jmp.com/scishow-dataviz 

Most animals use flashy color to signal to predators or to attract mates. But some animals---like pink armadillos and iridescent moles---have vastly different color adaptations than even their close cousins, thanks to weird, and sometimes transient, environmental pressures.

Hosted by: Denali Kincaid (they/them)
